topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: When I first heard the news about our little world turning into condos, my initial reaction was a mix of surprise and a quiet stirring of something I couldn’t quite place. It wasn’t just a home; it was a community of souls who shared these walls, these hallways, and these stories. Thinking about the neighbors, I found myself reaching out to them, one by one, checking in, making sure they felt as supported as I hoped they felt from me. In a way, this change brought us closer, sparking conversations and connections that hadn’t been there before. We started planning, not just for the transition, but for ways to keep the heart of our home beating, no matter what the future held.
